purpose: One-time generated, label-separated confirmatory challenge after validation candidate selection. This is not official bAbI test data.

generation_policy.entity_policy: Novel entity/location tokens generated per story; no overlap with official-test labels or training story identifiers
generation_policy.task11: Raw mention surface, pronoun flag, grammatical-gender cue, location and observation index; no resolved antecedent or entity binding in input. Query names target entity; labels contain answer location and supporting event IDs.
generation_policy.task14: Shuffled source-order temporal observations with explicit ordinal anchor feature and a before-destination query; labels contain previous temporal location and the target/predecessor witness events.
generation_policy.task19: Novel directed spatial chain and ordered route query; labels contain direction sequence and supporting edge IDs.
generation_policy.evaluator_separation: Inputs and labels are separate JSONL files. The generator rejects answer/support fields in every input/query/observation. Only query IDs are shared for evaluator joins.
generation_policy.no_training_access: Generated-confirmatory labels are never provided to warm-start or online-adaptation phases. They are read once after validation candidate selection.

source_claim_boundary: A generated challenge validates transfer to a separately generated distribution only; it is not an official bAbI benchmark result and is not a substitute for the frozen official-test policy.
freeze_note: The exact generated files are fixed by this committed generator, protocol and seed schedule. The runtime-generated manifest records SHA-256 for each task input and evaluator-label JSONL; the aggregate manifest hash is retained with CI artifacts.
